testcase.name: Scenario: Open two selected drawings together: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-document-opening-source/features/application/document-opening/document-opening.feature:357:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Open two selected drawings together ✔ Given writable copies of `fixtures/cad/document-opening/OpenDrawingA.odd`, `OpenDrawingB.odd` and `OpenPart.opd` are staged in the same working folder ✔ And the user opens each drawing, inserts a base view referencing the staged OpenPart.opd, saves it and closes it ✔ Given the MCAD Software has an existing document open ✔ And two saved drawings with available references and visible saved view geometry are not already open ✔ And the Open dialog displays both drawings as thumbnails ✔ And `OpenPart.opd` is open and `OpenDrawingA.odd` and `OpenDrawingB.odd` are closed ✔ When the user selects both drawing thumbnails with a selection rectangle ✔ And the user chooses Open ✔ Then the Open dialog closes ✔ And both drawings are available in separate document tabs ✔ And one of the drawings is active with its sheet and saved geometry displayed ✔ And the existing document tab remains available ✔ When the user selects the other drawing tab ✔ Then that drawing becomes active and its sheet is displayed
